      "text": "Home/Insights/PRODUCT ENGINEERINGPRODUCT ENGINEERINGPlan a smaller, stronger first MVP.Build the journey that tests your most important assumption.By Cubusify Editorial · Updated 18 October 2026On this pageWhat is a minimum viable product, and what is it not?How do you choose one customer, one problem and one journey?Which assumption should you test first?How do you scope MVP features with must, should and could?Should you build, buy or use no-code for the first test?How do you set milestones and success metrics before building?How can AI help plan an MVP without replacing user conversations?When is an MVP the wrong tool?What to do nextWhat to considerAn MVP is a learning tool: it exists to test your riskiest assumption with real users, not to ship a cheaper copy of the whole product.Scope around one customer, one problem and one complete journey that a user can start, finish and understand.Sort every feature into must, should or could, and cut anything you could do by hand for your first ten users.Define milestones as working outcomes and agree success metrics before building, so the result is a decision rather than an opinion.AI can speed up prototyping and research, but it cannot replace conversations with real customers.MVP development is the practice of building the smallest working version of a product that can test your riskiest assumption with real users. A minimum viable product is not a rough demo and not a thinned-out copy of your full vision. It is a complete but narrow first version: one customer, one problem and one journey that works from start to finish.To plan an MVP, name the customer and the problem, list your assumptions and pick the riskiest, sort features into must, should and could, and cut hard. Then define milestones as working outcomes and agree your success metrics before anyone writes code. The sections below take each step in turn, including when an MVP is the wrong tool.What is a minimum viable product, and what is it not?A minimum viable product is the smallest version of a product that delivers real value to a real user and teaches you something you could not learn by thinking. The word \"minimum\" limits the scope. The word \"viable\" sets the bar: someone must be able to complete a task and get a result they care about. Unlike a prototype, which may only show an idea, an MVP has to work for a user, even if it is narrow, manual in places and plain to look at.The most common mistake is treating the MVP as version one of the full product, with every feature made thinner. That gives you a wide, shallow build that tests nothing. A better frame is a question. For example, \"will clinic managers stop using a paper diary if booking takes two taps?\" is a question an MVP can answer. \"Will people like our platform?\" is not.How do you choose one customer, one problem and one journey?Choose the customer who feels the problem most often and already works around it, whether with a spreadsheet, a stack of messages or a paid tool they dislike. Narrow beats broad. A product for \"small businesses\" cannot be tested, because their needs differ too much. A product for one type of team with one painful weekly task can be. The workaround you can see today is evidence that the problem is real.Then write the journey as one sentence: \"A customer can complete one task and see the result without help.\" If the sentence needs three \"and\" clauses, it is really three journeys. Pick the one that, if it worked, would make the customer say they would switch or pay. Everything else waits.Who exactly is the first user, and how will you reach ten of them?What do they do today instead, and what does it cost them in time or errors?What is the single action that proves they got value?What must be true before they can start, such as data, access or an account?One-sentence ruleIf you cannot describe the journey in one sentence, or you cannot name ten real people who could try it, the scope is still too wide or the customer too vague. Fix that before you plan any features.Related interface showcase. Illustrates product capabilities; it is not evidence of a client result.Which assumption should you test first?Test the assumption that would end the project if it were wrong and for which you have the least evidence. Every product rests on assumptions about whether people want it (desirability), whether you can build it (feasibility) and whether the business works (viability). Assumption mapping makes them visible, so your first weeks go to the one that matters most rather than the one that is easiest to build.List every assumption behind your idea, one per line, such as \"managers will enter the data themselves\" or \"customers will pay monthly\".Score each one for the damage if it is wrong and for how little evidence you have today.Circle the ones that score high on both. These are your riskiest assumptions.Pick one and design the smallest test that could prove it wrong.Decide in advance what result would make you continue, change direction or stop.Often the riskiest assumption is not technical. It is \"will they change their habit?\" or \"will they give us access to their data?\" Test those with a conversation or a clickable mock-up first, and save engineering for assumptions only working software can test.How do you scope MVP features with must, should and could?Sort every candidate feature by one test: does the core journey fail without it? If yes, it is a must. If the journey works but is clumsier, it is a should. If it is merely nice to have, it is a could. Be strict: a real MVP scope has a short list of musts and a long list of coulds you will not touch.A scoping table for a hypothetical appointment-booking MVPBucketTest to applyExample featuresDecisionMustThe journey fails without itChoose a time slot, confirm the booking, see the confirmationBuild nowShouldThe journey works but is clumsier without itEmail reminder, reschedule linkBuild only if time remains after the mustsCouldNice to have, and no user has asked for it yetCalendar sync, loyalty points, custom themesLeave out and note in a backlogNot nowA real need, but risky or costly for a first testOnline payments, multiple locations, role permissionsReplace with a manual step or deferCutting is where most MVPs are won or lost. Common things to remove from a first version include admin panels (use a database view or spreadsheet instead), user roles and permissions (start with one role), settings pages, multiple payment methods, polished onboarding, reporting suites and integrations with tools your first users do not rely on. Each can be replaced by a manual step.Do it by hand firstIf a person can do a task for your first ten customers, do it by hand and learn from doing it. Automate it only once you know it matters and you understand how it really works.Should you build, buy or use no-code for the first test?Use the cheapest tool that can still answer your question. For a first test that may be a configured SaaS product, a no-code builder or a form connected to a spreadsheet. Custom code makes sense when the journey itself is the product, when a no-code tool cannot deliver the experience users need, or when the demand is already proven and you want to build it properly.Choosing a route for the first testRouteBest whenWatch out forBuild customThe experience or logic is the product, or you need control over data and performanceHighest upfront effort, and it is easy to build more than the test needsBuy or configure SaaSA standard tool already covers most of the journeyPer-user costs and limits on how far you can change itNo-code or low-codeYou need a working interface quickly to test demandLimits on scale, performance and data portability; a rebuild may followConcierge or manualYou are unsure the customer wants the outcome at allDoes not scale and does not test technical feasibilityNone of these choices is permanent. Many good products began as a no-code test and were rebuilt once demand was proven. If you are weighing longer-term tooling rather than a quick test, our custom software team can help assess the criteria.Related interface showcase. Illustrates product capabilities; it is not evidence of a client result.Can you fake the product first? The concierge and Wizard of Oz shortcutYes, and it is often the fastest route to learning. In a concierge MVP you deliver the outcome by hand and the customer knows it: you are the product. In a Wizard of Oz MVP the customer sees a working interface while people do the work behind it. Both test whether the outcome is wanted before you pay to automate it.These shortcuts have limits. They do not prove the software can be built, they do not scale, and they can hide how much manual effort the real product will need. Be honest with users about how their data is handled. AI can play part of the wizard, for example by drafting replies, but a person should check the output before a customer relies on it.How do you set milestones and success metrics before building?Define milestones as working outcomes a person can try, not as lists of screens. \"The login and dashboard pages are done\" tells you little. \"A new user can complete the booking journey on a phone and the clinic sees it\" tells you the product works. Each milestone ends with a demo, so you can see progress, correct course early and stop if the evidence says so.A user can start and finish the core journey on a test account.The first real users can complete it without help from the team.The person on the other side, such as the admin or manager, can see and act on the result.Events are recorded so you can see where people drop out.A review compares what happened with the success metric you agreed.Set success metrics before you build, while you are still neutral. Choose one primary metric tied to the journey, such as the share of started journeys that finish or the number of users who return unprompted. Write down the threshold that counts as success and what you will do if you miss it. Without this, every result can be explained away.Instrumentation is how you get the data. At a minimum, record when a user starts the journey, each step they complete, where they leave and when they finish. Pair those numbers with short conversations, because analytics show what happened and people tell you why. Add tracking in the first milestone. A review of the journey with user experience design before you build often removes a whole round of rework. This is also how we work at Cubusify under Results as a Service: define the goal, deliver in milestones with demos and measure what changes.How can AI help plan an MVP without replacing user conversations?AI is useful for speed during planning and weak at the thing that matters most: telling you what real customers want. Use it to draft, summarise and prototype. Do not use it to decide. A language model can produce confident, plausible answers about customers who do not exist, and it will not warn you when it is wrong.Summarise and tag interview notes or transcripts, once participants have agreed and sensitive details are removed, then check the themes against the originals.Draft user stories, acceptance criteria and test cases that your team reviews and edits.Generate clickable prototypes and sample data so you can put something in front of users sooner.Scan public competitor material and documentation for questions worth asking, treating the output as leads to verify rather than facts.What AI cannot do is replace talking to ten real people. Synthetic personas and AI-generated \"customer feedback\" are not evidence. Treat AI as a way to prepare better conversations and to build the test faster, never as the test itself.When is an MVP the wrong tool?An MVP is the wrong tool when the question is already answered or when \"minimum\" is not acceptable. If you are automating a well-understood internal process, the requirements are known and you should build the full solution in milestones. If the product handles payments, health records or other regulated data, security and compliance cannot be trimmed to fit a first test. And if you cannot reach any real users, building will not fix that. Sometimes the cheaper test is no software at all: a landing page or a manual pilot. If one of those can answer your riskiest assumption, do that first.What to do nextThis week, write your one-sentence journey, list your assumptions and circle the riskiest. Then sort your feature list into must, should and could, and challenge every must. Bring that page, plus a sketch or your current spreadsheet, to a conversation. Concrete examples make scope easier to agree.If you would like a second pair of eyes, our MVP development work starts with exactly this: discovery, scope and a milestone plan. Cost and timeline depend on the scope, so the sensible first step is a short conversation. Talk to us about your MVP when you are ready.Discuss your projectFor clearer search foundations and useful answers, explore our SEO, AEO and GEO services.CONTINUE READINGAnother useful perspective.SEO, AEO and GEO: where should your business start? ↗Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom store? ↗Where AI automation is actually useful. ↗",

.celestial{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.sun,.moon{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;transition:left 1.6s ease,top 1.6s ease,opacity 1.2s ease}
.sun{width:110px;height:110px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 42% 40%,#FFF6DC,#FFE59A 45%,#FFD16B 75%);box-shadow:0 0 90px 30px rgba(255,214,120,.55),0 0 40px 8px rgba(255,240,190,.7);opacity:0}
html[data-phase="dawn"] .sun,html[data-phase="day"] .sun,html[data-phase="afternoon"] .sun,html[data-phase="dusk"] .sun{opacity:1}
.moon{width:88px;height:88px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 36%,#FCFCFF,#D9E2FF 55%,#AEB9E6 100%);box-shadow:0 0 70px 18px rgba(190,210,255,.4);opacity:0}
.moon::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:inset -22px -10px 0 -4px rgba(140,155,205,.35)}
html[data-phase="night"] .moon{opacity:1}

.stars{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.6s ease}
html[data-phase="night"] .stars{opacity:1}
.star{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:tw 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tw{0%,100%{opacity:.2}50%{opacity:.95}}
.shooting{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 6px 2px rgba(255,255,255,.7)}

.clouds{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.6s ease}
html[data-phase="day"] .clouds,html[data-phase="afternoon"] .clouds{opacity:.9}
html[data-phase="dawn"] .clouds{opacity:.5}
.cloud{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:100px;filter:blur(2px);opacity:.85}
.cloud::before,.cloud::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}
.cloud.a{width:150px;height:34px;top:16%;left:-220px;animation:drift 62s linear infinite}
.cloud.b{width:110px;height:26px;top:26%;left:-220px;animation:drift 88s linear infinite;animation-delay:-20s}
.cloud.c{width:190px;height:40px;top:11%;left:-280px;animation:drift 104s linear infinite;animation-delay:-50s}
.cloud::before{width:56px;height:56px;top:-24px;left:26px}.cloud::after{width:44px;height:44px;top:-16px;right:30px}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translateX(calc(100vw + 340px))}}

.content{position:relative;z-index:5}

.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .25s,background 1.2s,color 1.2s}
.btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);box-shadow:0 12px 30px -12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 70%,transparent)}
.btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.btn-ghost:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn .arr{transition:transform .25s}.btn:hover .arr{transform:translateX(3px)}

nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;transition:background .4s,backdrop-filter .4s}
nav.scrolled{background:var(--panel);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--panel-brd)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 30px;gap:16px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:21px}
.brand .m{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;transition:background 1.2s,color 1.2s}
.brand .logo{width:30px;height:30px;flex:0 0 auto;display:block}
.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.clockchip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:100px;font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:13px;transition:background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s}
.clockchip .ph{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s}
.clockchip .tz{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.nav-cta{padding:11px 20px;font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:860px){.clockchip .tz{display:none}.nav-cta{display:none}}

.tt{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:120;display:flex;gap:6px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);padding:6px;border-radius:100px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s}
.tt button{border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:11px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:100px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .25s,color .25s}
.tt button:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.tt button.on{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}
@media(max-width:600px){.tt{right:12px;bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:150px;justify-content:center}}

.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:130px 0 80px}
.greet{font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:clamp(15px,1.9vw,19px);color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-weight:400}
.greet #greet{font-weight:700}
.greet #greetWord{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;transition:color 1.2s}
.greet .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,7.6vw,94px);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:22px;max-width:15ch}
.hero h1 .accent{color:var(--accent);transition:color 1.2s}
.mood{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(15px,1.7vw,18px);color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:color 1.2s}
.hero p.lead{font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,21px);color:var(--muted);max-width:560px;margin-bottom:34px}
.hero .cta-row{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.band{padding:110px 0}
.glass{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-radius:22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s,transform .3s}
.sec-top{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:46px}
.kick{display:inline-block;font-family:'Space Mono';font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:16px;transition:color 1.2s,background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s}
.h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,52px);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:16px}
.lead2{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted)}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.d1{transition-delay:.07s}.d2{transition-delay:.14s}.d3{transition-delay:.21s}

.feat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:50px}
.fcard{padding:32px}.fcard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.fcard .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 16%,transparent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:20px;color:var(--accent);transition:color 1.2s,background 1.2s}
.fcard h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px}
.fcard p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:860px){.feat{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.why-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:48px}
.value{padding:30px}.value:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
.value .n{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:12px;transition:color 1.2s}
.value h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:9px}.value p{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:760px){.why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.proc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:50px}
.pstep{padding:28px 24px}
.pstep .num{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--accent-ink);background:var(--accent);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;transition:background 1.2s,color 1.2s}
.pstep h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:19px;margin-bottom:10px}.pstep p{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:860px){.proc{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:480px){.proc{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.contact .card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;overflow:hidden}
.contact .ci{padding:44px}
.contact h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,46px);margin-bottom:16px}
.contact .ci p{font-size:17px;color:var(--muted);max-width:380px;margin-bottom:24px}
.cpoint{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cpoint svg{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--accent)}
.form-side{padding:44px;background:var(--field-bg);border-left:1px solid var(--panel-brd);transition:background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s}
.field{margin-bottom:16px}.field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px}.field label .req{color:var(--accent)}
.field input,.field textarea{width:100%;font-family:'Inter';font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--field-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--panel-brd);border-radius:11px;padding:13px 14px;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:104px}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 18%,transparent)}
.field.err input,.field.err textarea{border-color:#E0574F}
.field .msg{font-size:12px;color:#E0574F;margin-top:6px;display:none}.field.err .msg{display:block}
.frow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.submit{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin-top:4px}
.form-foot{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:12px}
.success{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:24px 6px}.success.show{display:flex}
.success .ring{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:18px;animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(0)}to{transform:scale(1)}}
.success h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px}.success p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:820px){.contact .card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.form-side{border-left:none;border-top:1px solid var(--panel-brd)}.frow{grid-template-columns:1fr}.contact .ci,.form-side{padding:30px 24px}}

footer{padding:70px 0 34px}
.foot-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:32px 38px;margin-bottom:54px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.foot-cta h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(22px,3vw,30px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:6px}
.foot-cta p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;max-width:420px}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1.1fr;gap:36px 30px}
@media(max-width:820px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px 24px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
footer .brandcol .brand{margin-bottom:14px}
footer .tagline{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);max-width:320px;margin-bottom:20px}
footer .socials{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
footer .socials a{width:38px;height:38px;min-width:38px;min-height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s,transform .25s,border-color 1.2s,background 1.2s}
footer .socials a svg{flex:0 0 auto}
footer .socials a:hover{color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-2px)}
footer .fcol h4{font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:15px;opacity:.75}
footer .fcol a{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:11px;transition:color .2s}
footer .fcol a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
footer .fcol .meta{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
footer .fcol .meta svg{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--accent);transition:color 1.2s}
.fbar{border-top:1px solid var(--panel-brd);margin-top:54px;padding-top:24px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;transition:border-color 1.2s}
.fbar .fbar-links a{color:var(--muted);margin-left:18px;transition:color .2s}
.fbar .fbar-links a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.fbar .tzbadge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.fbar .tzbadge .d{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s}

/* trust line */
.trustline{margin-top:26px;font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.trustline span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.trustline .d{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s}

/* who */
.who-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:46px}
.who{padding:28px}
.who .wi{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 16%,transparent);color:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;transition:color 1.2s,background 1.2s}
.who h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:8px}
.who p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:860px){.who-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:480px){.who-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* engagement */
.eng-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:46px}
.eng{padding:34px 30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative}
.eng.feat{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-1px}
.eng .badge{align-self:flex-start;font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-ink);background:var(--accent);padding:4px 11px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:14px;transition:background 1.2s,color 1.2s}
.eng h3{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:21px;margin-bottom:5px}
.eng .price{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:18px;transition:color 1.2s}
.eng ul{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;margin-bottom:auto}
.eng li{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.eng li svg{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--accent);margin-top:3px;transition:color 1.2s}
.eng .btn{margin-top:24px;justify-content:center}
@media(max-width:860px){.eng-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* testimonials */
.tst-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:46px}
.tst{padding:30px}
.tst .stars5{color:var(--accent);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:14px;transition:color 1.2s}
.tst .q{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:20px}
.tst .who2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.tst .av{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;flex:0 0 auto;transition:background 1.2s,color 1.2s}
.tst .nm{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}.tst .rl{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:860px){.tst-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* faq */
.faq{max-width:840px;margin:46px auto 0}
.qa{border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-brd);transition:border-color 1.2s}
.qa button{width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;color:var(--ink);font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:18px;padding:22px 4px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;transition:color 1.2s}
.qa .pl{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;width:18px;height:18px}
.qa .pl::before,.qa .pl::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .3s,background 1.2s}
.qa .pl::before{top:8px;left:0;width:18px;height:2px}
.qa .pl::after{left:8px;top:0;width:2px;height:18px}
.qa.open .pl::after{transform:scaleY(0)}
.qa .a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .35s ease}
.qa.open .a{max-height:260px}
.qa .a p{padding:0 4px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}

@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}.sun,.moon,.layer,.stars,.clouds{transition:opacity .3s}}

<header class="hero"><div class="wrap">

    <span><span class="d"></span>You own all the code &amp; IP</span>
    <span><span class="d"></span>NDA available on request</span>

</div></header>

<section class="band" id="build"><div class="wrap">

    <div class="fcard glass reveal d1"><div class="ic"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M16 18l6-6-6-6M8 6l-6 6 6 6"/></svg></div><h3>Custom software</h3><p>Web platforms, SaaS and internal tools, engineered around how you actually work.</p></div>

    <div class="fcard glass reveal d1"><div class="ic"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4"/><rect x="13" y="3" width="8" height="8" rx="1"/><path d="M4 21l4.5-8 4.5 8z"/></svg></div><h3>Product &amp; graphic design</h3><p>Interfaces, logos and brand visuals — design that makes your product look and feel right.</p></div>

<style>
.demo-shell{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.demo-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--panel-brd);transition:border-color 1.2s}
.demo-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 60%,transparent);animation:demoPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes demoPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 0%,transparent)}}
.demo-title{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.demo-status{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:'Space Mono';font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.demo-status .d{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);transition:background 1.2s}
.demo-thread{padding:20px;min-height:170px;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;scroll-behavior:smooth}
.dmsg{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;align-items:flex-start;animation:dIn .4s cubic-bezier(.2,1,.3,1)}
@keyframes dIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.dmsg .dav{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);transition:background 1.2s}
.dmsg .dbub{background:var(--field-bg);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;max-width:78%;transition:background 1.2s,border-color 1.2s}
.dmsg.duser{flex-direction:row-reverse}
.dmsg.duser .dav{background:var(--panel);color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd)}
.dmsg.duser .dbub{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 14%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 30%,transparent)}
.dcursor{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:13px;background:var(--accent);vertical-align:-2px;margin-left:1px;animation:dBlink 1s steps(1) infinite;transition:background 1.2s}
@keyframes dBlink{50%{opacity:0}}
.demo-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:0 20px 16px}
.demo-chips button{font-family:'Inter';font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);border-radius:100px;padding:7px 13px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s}
.demo-chips button:hover{border-color:var(--accent);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.demo-row{display:flex;gap:9px;padding:16px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--panel-brd);transition:border-color 1.2s}
.demo-row input{flex:1;font-family:'Inter';font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--field-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--panel-brd);border-radius:11px;padding:11px 14px;transition:border-color .2s}
.demo-row input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent)}
.demo-foot{text-align:center;margin-top:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px}
.demo-foot a{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:560px){.demo-row{flex-direction:column}.demo-row button{width:100%}}
</style>

<section class="band" id="why"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="sec-top reveal"><div class="kick">Why Cubusify</div><h2 class="h2 disp">Built solid. Shipped fast.</h2><p class="lead2">Plenty of teams write code. Fewer ship the right thing, cleanly, in a way that still makes sense a year later.</p></div>
  <div class="why-grid">
    <div class="value glass reveal d1"><div class="n">01</div><h3>Ships on time, without shortcuts</h3><p>We move fast because we've done this before, not because we cut corners — you get something real, on a timeline you can count on.</p></div>
    <div class="value glass reveal d2"><div class="n">02</div><h3>One team, end to end</h3><p>Design, engineering and AI under one roof — no juggling vendors, no gaps where things fall through.</p></div>
    <div class="value glass reveal d1"><div class="n">03</div><h3>Clear communication, steady momentum</h3><p>No jargon, no disappearing. A clear plan, visible weekly progress, and you always know what's landing next.</p></div>
    <div class="value glass reveal d2"><div class="n">04</div><h3>Built to last, not rebuilt in a year</h3><p>Modern, AI-native architecture that scales with you — an asset that grows, not debt you inherit.</p></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="band" id="process"><div class="wrap">

<section class="band" id="faq"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="sec-top reveal" style="text-align:center;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto"><div class="kick">Questions, answered</div><h2 class="h2 disp">Everything you might be wondering.</h2></div>
  <div class="faq">
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>How much will my project cost?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Every project is different, so we quote after a short call. You'll always get a clear, fixed price up front — no surprise invoices, ever.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>How long does it take?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Smaller builds can ship in a few weeks; larger products take longer. We give you a realistic timeline in our first proposal, and we stick to it.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>Will I own the code and IP?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Yes — completely. Everything we build is yours: the code, the designs, the accounts. We're happy to sign an NDA before we even start.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>How do we stay in touch?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>You get a direct line to the people building your product, plus regular progress updates. No account managers, no ticket queues, no chasing.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>What if I only have a rough idea?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>That's perfectly fine — most people start there. Shaping a rough idea into a clear, buildable plan is a big part of what we do. Bring what you have.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>Do you work with clients in other countries?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Yes — we're happy to work with clients anywhere, and we adapt to your timezone. (This page already adjusts to your local time — you may have noticed.)</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>Do you take on larger or enterprise-scale projects?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Yes — we work with everything from lean startups to large organizations taking on big builds. Bigger scope just means more structure: clearer milestones, more regular check-ins, and the same upfront, fixed pricing.</p></div></div>
    <div class="qa reveal"><button>Can you fix bugs or support software you didn't build?<span class="pl"></span></button><div class="a"><p>Yes — we regularly step into existing sites and codebases, ours or someone else's. We get familiar with what's there, fix what's broken, and can set up ongoing support from that point on.</p></div></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="band contact" id="contact"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="card glass reveal">
    <div class="ci">
      <div class="kick">Start a project</div>
      <h2 class="disp">Tell us what you want to build.</h2>
      <p>Send a few lines about your idea. We'll reply with how we'd approach it — scope, timeline, and price.</p>
      <div class="cpoint"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg>A clear, honest quote</div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-side">
      <form id="contactForm" novalidate>
        <div class="frow">
          <div class="field"><label>Name <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="text" id="f-name" placeholder="Your name"><span class="msg">Please enter your name</span></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Email <span class="req">*</span></label><input type="email" id="f-email" placeholder="you@company.com"><span class="msg">Enter a valid email</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field"><label>Company</label><input type="text" id="f-company" placeholder="Optional"></div>
        <div class="field"><label>What do you want to build? <span class="req">*</span></label><textarea id="f-message" placeholder="Tell us the idea and roughly what you need."></textarea><span class="msg">Tell us a little about your project</span></div>
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary submit">Send project brief <span class="arr">→</span></button>
        <p class="form-foot">Or email <a href="mailto:hello@cubusify.com" style="color:var(--accent);font-weight:600">hello@cubusify.com</a></p>
      </form>
      <div class="success" id="formSuccess"><div class="ring"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 6L9 17l-5-5"/></svg></div><h3 class="disp">Thank you!</h3><p>We'll be in touch within one business day.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div></section>

        <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/cubusify" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="LinkedIn" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--panel-brd);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--muted)"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M20.45 20.45h-3.56v-5.57c0-1.33-.02-3.04-1.85-3.04-1.85 0-2.14 1.45-2.14 2.94v5.67H9.35V9h3.42v1.56h.05c.48-.9 1.64-1.85 3.37-1.85 3.6 0 4.27 2.37 4.27 5.46v6.28zM5.34 7.43a2.06 2.06 0 1 1 0-4.13 2.06 2.06 0 0 1 0 4.13zM7.12 20.45H3.55V9h3.57v11.45zM22.22 0H1.77C.8 0 0 .78 0 1.75v20.5C0 23.2.8 24 1.77 24h20.45c.98 0 1.78-.8 1.78-1.75V1.75C24 .78 23.2 0 22.22 0z"/></svg></a>

<script>
const root=document.documentElement;
document.getElementById('yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
(function(){const s=document.getElementById('stars');let h='';for(let i=0;i<90;i++){const top=Math.random()*80,left=Math.random()*100,sz=Math.random()*2+0.6,d=Math.random()*4;h+=`<span class="star" style="top:${top}%;left:${left}%;width:${sz}px;height:${sz}px;animation-delay:${d}s"></span>`;}s.innerHTML=h;})();

function phaseFor(h){ if(h<5||h>=21)return'night'; if(h<8)return'dawn'; if(h<16)return'day'; if(h<19)return'afternoon'; return'dusk'; }
function greetFor(h){ if(h<5)return'Working late?'; if(h<12)return'Good morning'; if(h<17)return'Good afternoon'; if(h<21)return'Good evening'; return'Good night'; }
const THEME={
  dawn:{mood:'A fresh start.',word:'first light.',lead:'Good morning. Cubusify designs and builds the software and AI your business runs on. Let\'s make yours take shape today.'},
  day:{mood:'Full speed ahead.',word:'broad daylight.',lead:'Cubusify designs and builds the software and AI your business runs on — with care, built to last, wherever you are.'},
  afternoon:{mood:'Golden and getting things done.',word:'the afternoon.',lead:'The afternoon is for building. Cubusify designs and engineers the software and AI your business runs on.'},
  dusk:{mood:'Winding down, thinking big.',word:'golden hour.',lead:'Good evening. Cubusify designs and builds the software and AI your business runs on — ready to build something great together.'},
  night:{mood:'The best ideas arrive late.',word:'the small hours.',lead:'Working late? So do great ideas. Cubusify designs and engineers the software and AI your business runs on.'}
};
function positionCelestial(hf){
  const sun=document.getElementById('sun'),moon=document.getElementById('moon');
  let ds=(hf-5)/(20-5);ds=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ds));
  sun.style.left=`calc(${5+ds*88}% - 55px)`;sun.style.top=`calc(${72-Math.sin(ds*Math.PI)*58}% - 55px)`;
  let hn=hf;if(hn<5)hn+=24;let ns=(hn-20)/(29-20);ns=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ns));
  moon.style.left=`calc(${5+ns*88}% - 44px)`;moon.style.top=`calc(${72-Math.sin(ns*Math.PI)*58}% - 44px)`;
}
let manual=null;
function applyTime(){
  const now=new Date(),h=now.getHours(),hf=h+now.getMinutes()/60;
  const phase=manual||phaseFor(h);
  root.setAttribute('data-phase',phase);
  const rep={dawn:6.5,day:12,afternoon:17.5,dusk:20,night:1}[phase];
  positionCelestial(manual?rep:hf);
  const tstr=now.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
  document.getElementById('clk').textContent=tstr;
  document.getElementById('greetWord').textContent=THEME[phase].word.replace('.','');
  document.getElementById('greet').textContent=greetFor(h);
  try{document.getElementById('tz').textContent=Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone.replace(/_/g,' ');}catch(e){}
}
applyTime();setInterval(applyTime,30000);
document.querySelectorAll('.tt button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.tt button').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('on'));b.classList.add('on');const s=b.dataset.set;manual=(s==='auto')?null:s;applyTime();}));

setInterval(()=>{if(root.getAttribute('data-phase')!=='night')return;const sc=document.getElementById('stars');const el=document.createElement('span');el.className='shooting';el.style.left=(Math.random()*60+20)+'%';el.style.top=(Math.random()*30+5)+'%';sc.appendChild(el);el.animate([{transform:'translate(0,0)',opacity:0},{opacity:1,offset:.1},{transform:'translate(240px,120px)',opacity:0}],{duration:1100,easing:'ease-out'});setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),1200);},7000);

document.querySelectorAll('.qa button').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{b.parentElement.classList.toggle('open');}));

const nav=document.getElementById('nav');addEventListener('scroll',()=>nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>30),{passive:true});
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.12,rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

const WEB3FORMS_KEY="af1b79f6-8422-4c47-bc2a-585b2ce5912c",YOUR_EMAIL="hello@cubusify.com";

/* ---- Live demo widget: real answers about Cubusify ---- */
(function(){
  const thread=document.getElementById('demoThread'),chipsEl=document.getElementById('demoChips'),
        inp=document.getElementById('demoInput'),send=document.getElementById('demoSend');
  if(!thread)return;
  const pick=a=>a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)];
  const KB=[
    {k:['cost','price','pricing','how much','budget','charge'],a:"Every project is different, so we quote after a short call. You'll always get a clear, fixed price up front — no surprise invoices, ever."},
    {k:['how long','timeline','when','fast','weeks','months'],a:"Smaller builds can ship in a few weeks; larger products take longer. You'll get a realistic timeline in our first proposal, and we stick to it."},
    {k:['own','ip','code','rights'],a:"Yes — completely. Everything we build is yours: the code, the designs, the accounts. We're happy to sign an NDA before we even start."},
    {k:['touch','update','communication','contact you','reach'],a:"You get a direct line to the people building your product, plus regular progress updates. No account managers, no ticket queues, no chasing."},
    {k:['rough idea','no idea','not sure what','just an idea','early stage'],a:"That's perfectly fine — most people start there. Shaping a rough idea into a clear, buildable plan is a big part of what we do. Bring what you have."},
    {k:['other countries','worldwide','international','timezone','abroad'],a:"Yes — we're happy to work with clients anywhere, and we adapt to your timezone. (This page already adjusts to your local time — you may have noticed.)"},
    {k:['what do you build','what you build','services','offer','build software'],a:"Custom software, AI assistants and automation, websites & mobile apps, graphic and product design, cloud & integrations, plus ongoing bug-fix support — one team, under one roof."},
    {k:['enterprise','big project','large project','big company','large company','industry project'],a:"Definitely — we take on large, enterprise-scale projects as well as small ones. Bigger scope just means more structure: clearer milestones and more regular check-ins along the way."},
    {k:['bug','broken','not working','fix my','ongoing support'],a:"Yes — we fix bugs and offer ongoing support, even on sites or software we didn't originally build. Tell us what's going on and we'll take a look."},
    {k:['website','graphic design','logo','branding','brand identity'],a:"Yes — website design and builds, plus graphic design and branding, are both things we do. Tell us what you need and we'll show you how we'd approach it."},
    {k:['ai','automation','assistant','chatbot'],a:"AI is core to what we build — assistants, automation, and workflows that take real work off your team's plate. This chat is a small example of it."},
    {k:['guarantee','refund','risk','not happy'],a:"If you're not happy with the first version, you don't pay for it. We'd rather earn the rest of the project than lock you into one."},
    {k:['hi','hello','hey','good morning','good evening'],a:"Hi there! Ask me anything about working with Cubusify — pricing, timelines, how we work, anything."},
    {k:['thank','thanks'],a:"Anytime! Anything else you'd like to know?"},
    {k:['help','what can you','what can i ask'],a:"Ask about pricing, timelines, who owns the code, how we communicate, or what we build. Or just say hi."}
  ];
  const qFall=["Good question — for anything that specific, our team can give you a straight answer on a quick call. Want to start a project and ask there?","That's a bit beyond this quick preview — but ask about pricing, timelines, IP, or how we work, and I'll answer directly."];
  const sFall=["Got it. I can help with questions about pricing, timelines, how we work, or what we build — ask away.","Noted! This preview focuses on questions about working with Cubusify — try asking about pricing or timelines."];
  let lastFall=-1;
  function pickFall(arr){let i;do{i=Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length);}while(arr.length>1&&i===lastFall);lastFall=i;return arr[i];}
  function reply(raw){const low=raw.toLowerCase();let best=null,score=0;
    for(const it of KB){for(const p of it.k){if(low.includes(p)&&p.length>score){score=p.length;best=it;}}}
    if(best)return best.a;
    return raw.includes('?')?pickFall(qFall):pickFall(sFall);
  }
  function scroll(){thread.scrollTop=thread.scrollHeight;}
  function addUser(text){const m=document.createElement('div');m.className='dmsg duser';m.innerHTML='<div class="dav">You</div><div class="dbub"></div>';m.querySelector('.dbub').textContent=text;thread.appendChild(m);scroll();}
  function addBotBubble(){const m=document.createElement('div');m.className='dmsg';m.innerHTML='<div class="dav">C</div><div class="dbub"></div>';thread.appendChild(m);scroll();return m.querySelector('.dbub');}
  function type(el,text,done){el.innerHTML='';let i=0;el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="dcursor"></span>');const cur=el.querySelector('.dcursor');
    (function s(){if(i<text.length){cur.insertAdjacentText('beforebegin',text[i++]);scroll();setTimeout(s,14);}else{cur.remove();done&&done();}})();}
  function botSay(text,cb){const b=addBotBubble();setTimeout(()=>type(b,text,cb),380);}

  const STARTERS=["How much does a project cost?","How long does it take?","Do I own the code?","What do you build?"];
  function renderChips(){chipsEl.innerHTML='';STARTERS.forEach(q=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=q;b.onclick=()=>{addUser(q);botSay(reply(q));};chipsEl.appendChild(b);});}

  function ask(){const v=inp.value.trim();if(!v)return;inp.value='';addUser(v);botSay(reply(v));}
  send.addEventListener('click',ask);
  inp.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')ask();});

  /* auto-played opening exchange so scrollers see it work with zero interaction */
  let played=false;
  function playIntro(){
    if(played)return;played=true;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      addUser("Are you open to new projects right now?");
      botSay("Yes — we're taking on new projects now. Tell me a bit about what you're building and I'll point you the right way, or ask me about pricing, timelines, or how we work.",renderChips);
    },500);
  }
  const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){playIntro();io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.4});
  io.observe(thread);
})();

const form=document.getElementById('contactForm'),sb=document.getElementById('formSuccess');
const fName=document.getElementById('f-name'),fEmail=document.getElementById('f-email'),fCompany=document.getElementById('f-company'),fMessage=document.getElementById('f-message');
const setErr=(id,on)=>document.getElementById(id).closest('.field').classList.toggle('err',on);
const ve=v=>/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v);
function validateField(el){
  if(el===fName){const on=!fName.value.trim();setErr('f-name',on);return!on;}
  if(el===fEmail){const on=!ve(fEmail.value.trim());setErr('f-email',on);return!on;}
  if(el===fMessage){const on=!fMessage.value.trim();setErr('f-message',on);return!on;}
  return true;
}
/* validate as the visitor types/leaves a field, not only on submit */
[fName,fEmail,fMessage].forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('blur',()=>validateField(el));
  el.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(el.closest('.field').classList.contains('err'))validateField(el);});
});
form.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const n=fName.value.trim(),em=fEmail.value.trim(),co=fCompany.value.trim(),ms=fMessage.value.trim();
  const validName=validateField(fName),validEmail=validateField(fEmail),validMsg=validateField(fMessage);
  if(!validName||!validEmail||!validMsg){
    const firstBad=[fName,fEmail,fMessage].find(el=>el.closest('.field').classList.contains('err'));
    if(firstBad)firstBad.focus();
    return;
  }
  const b=form.querySelector('.submit');const originalLabel=b.innerHTML;b.textContent='Sending…';b.disabled=true;
  const done=()=>{form.style.display='none';sb.classList.add('show');};
  const restore=()=>{b.innerHTML=originalLabel;b.disabled=false;};
  if(WEB3FORMS_KEY&&WEB3FORMS_KEY!=="YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY"){
    try{
      const r=await fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({access_key:WEB3FORMS_KEY,subject:'New project brief from '+n,name:n,email:em,company:co,message:ms})});
      if(r.ok){done();return;}
      restore();
    }catch(_){restore();}
  }
  location.href=`mailto:${YOUR_EMAIL}?subject=${encodeURIComponent('New project brief from '+n)}&body=${encodeURIComponent('Name: '+n+'\nEmail: '+em+'\nCompany: '+(co||'-')+'\n\nProject:\n'+ms)}`;
  setTimeout(done,400);
});
</script>
</body>
